structural_gaps.detail: Indexed bit widths do not bind physical storage/pointers/endianness, allocation extent, i32 pid/offset/mask arithmetic or address overflow.
Option and absent-input outcomes do not prove native poison propagation, trap/sanitizer behavior, wrapper dispatch, allocations or Python/Torch composition.
